checks.detail: no pixel bootstrap in served HTML. Fix: install via Meta's Facebook Channel app on Shopify (Settings > Channels > Meta), or GTM if the store already uses it.
missing ViewContent: add pageview/ViewContent in Meta channel app or a pageview tag in GTM (Shopify metafields or theme snippet).
missing AddToCart: Shopify Meta channel fires this from cart actions; if absent, add fbq track on cart-add event in theme.
missing InitiateCheckout: Shopify Meta channel covers it on checkout step one; otherwise track on order start.
missing Purchase: this is the event Meta optimises spend on. Enable the Meta (Facebook) channel app so Shopify posts Purchase via Conversion API on completed orders.
no pixel in the served HTML, so dedup cannot be assessed
no pixel delivery path found in served HTML (neither GTM nor direct)
